00001| //! Regression coverage for issue #977: timeouts that hid as cancellations.
00002| //!
00003| //! A job killed by `timeout-minutes` is reported by GitHub as **cancelled**,
00004| //! not **failed**, and a run whose only non-success job is cancelled inherits
00005| //! the benign-looking `cancelled` conclusion. Eighteen consecutive `main` runs
00006| //! went untriaged that way while `Auto Release` timed out mid-Docker-build, so
00007| //! eleven versions (0.326.2 .. 0.333.0) reached crates.io and git tags with no
00008| //! GitHub Release at all. The reconstruction is in

00158| /// Run 31065367736 died at "Compiling fs2 v0.4.3" because the release Docker
00159| /// builds recompiled the crate from scratch -- the PR-check build had used the
00160| /// GHA layer cache all along, the release builds never did.
00161| #[test]
00162| fn every_docker_build_push_step_uses_the_gha_layer_cache() {
00163|     let workflow = release_workflow();
00164| 
00165|     let build_steps: Vec<&str> = workflow
00166|         .split("docker/build-push-action@")
00167|         .skip(1)
00168|         .collect();
00169| 
00170|     assert!(
00171|         build_steps.len() >= 4,
00172|         "expected the GHCR and Docker Hub publish steps in both auto-release \
00173|          and manual-release, found {}",
00174|         build_steps.len()
00175|     );
00176| 
00177|     for (index, step) in build_steps.iter().enumerate() {
00178|         let body = step.split("\n      - ").next().expect("step body");
00179|         assert!(
00180|             body.contains("cache-from: type=gha"),
00181|             "docker build-push step #{index} has no `cache-from: type=gha`; \
00182|              an uncached release build recompiles the whole crate and blew the \
00183|              job budget in run 31065367736 (issue #977)"
00184|         );
00185|         // Issue #1057 narrowed this from "every step exports" to "every step
00186|         // that builds from source exports". The cache is one 10GB pool shared
00187|         // with sccache; it reached 10.01GB with buildkit holding 5.26GB against
00188|         // sccache's 2.44GB, and the compile cache was being evicted to store
00189|         // layers -- the macOS specification lane fell from a 48% to a 27% hit
00190|         // rate and died at its budget with no test run.
00191|         //
00192|         // A step that copies a prebuilt binary compiles nothing worth keeping,
00193|         // and a second publish step exports layers the first already wrote. Both
00194|         // still *read* the cache, which is what keeps the uncached release build
00195|         // this test was written for from coming back.
00196|         // `body` starts after the action name, so the step's own name is not in
00197|         // it; `cache-to: type=inline` is the marker a non-exporting step
00198|         // carries, and it is only ever set deliberately.
00199|         let exports_deliberately_skipped = body.contains("cache-to: type=inline");
00200|         assert!(
00201|             exports_deliberately_skipped || body.contains("cache-to: type=gha,mode=max"),
00202|             "docker build-push step #{index} builds from source but has no \
00203|              `cache-to: type=gha,mode=max`"
00204|         );
00205|     }
00206| }

00460|         std::fs::write(&output_file, "").expect("output file");
